notes: This distillation re-extracted heavily from the source rather than copying from the deep ref: seven [V] quotations (liaison, restorative-justice second sentence, two-interviewer, full Readback, focus-group list, LRB composition, and the peers passage's last sentence) are true to the source but absent from the deep ref. They are graded MINOR-DRIFT, and the continuity note's claim that they are [V] in the deep ref is wrong. The better fix is to extend the deep ref's Part 5, Part 6 (Participants, Agenda), Part 8, Part 10-11 and Appendix C coverage, which this and the decision-making and software-business distillations all lean on. Real errors: the 'anchoring' bias attributed to Handout C's unextracted list (line 98); the restorative-justice obligation claim (line 144); Kahneman misattributed as the System 1/2 source for the Ten Principles (line 235); wrong marker counts (line 249). The deflection-question guidance (lines 42, 96, 206) matches the source. The worked example is operator-authored, labelled as such, and presents no outcome as the source's finding. Other-source checks: NHS decision tree, TC 25-20 horseshoe seating (tc deep 221), SSDL mental models / feedback / accumulations, OB groupthink (ob deep 200-202) and Barbrook-Johnson boundary objects (bj deep 255) are faithful.
